sources.document_title: TPS255xx Precision Adjustable Current-Limited Power-Distribution Switches datasheet (TPS2552, TPS2552-1, TPS2553, TPS2553-1)
sources.locator: SLVS841G physical PDF page 18 of 46 (index 17), printed page 18: Section 9.1.1 Constant-Current vs Latch-Off Operation and Impact on Output Voltage, final paragraph on latch-off devices (TPS255x-1)
sources.evidence_extract: The latch-off devices (TPS255x-1) assert the FAULT flag after the deglitch period and immediately turn off the device. The device remains off regardless of whether the overload condition is removed. The latch-off devices remain off and do not resume normal operation until the surrounding system either toggles the enable or cycles power to the device.
